test(keepalive-r2 A r3): S4 -- a parked client behind the relay sends every session packet; the relay stand-in is per-client only

Codex codex_keepalive_r2_spike_r1.md S4. The relay stand-in now has one mode, decision (a): a host-facing socket per
client lease, host->client routed by the socket a datagram arrived on, nothing read from it. The shared mode (b) and
its lastActivated routing -- moved by a StandbyActivate SEEN, before the host accepted it -- are gone.

With B active through the relay, parked C now sends window-select, control ACK, control NACK, video NACK, resume and
a bulk-shaped datagram, plus a wrong-secret and a gen-0 activation: none is processed, C's leg gets nothing back but
Standby* replies, C's resume is ignored as another peer's, B keeps its epoch with no control-session end, and the
host still answers B's next select down B's own leg.

e2e --old-host <capture-lifecycle baseline GNLinkStream>: 67/67. Mutant KS4 (C's SESSION packets leave through B's
host-facing socket, i.e. one shared host address; Standby* keeps its own leg) -> 2 FAIL: C's control processed, B's
session disturbed.

Product / test / docs: product (none) / test (standby admission e2e) / docs (none).
